NOTE
**Still not ready — linked thread is only the author's own post, with no maintainer agreement**

New: The author linked a chat.zulip.org thread, but they started it themselves and no one has replied. There was no new push. Missing: A maintainer agreeing the change is wanted, and a filled-in PR description (the "Fixes:" line is empty and testing is just "Verified no test failures").

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; no reviewer needed until someone responds in the thread.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for starting the thread! Please wait for a maintainer to weigh in there on whether this approach is wanted, and meanwhile update the PR description with how you tested (see the [PR guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/pull-requests.html)).
```
